relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He considers Dilgo Khyentse as his main guru.

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He is the eldest son of Thinley Norbu

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: and therefore the grandson of Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje.

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: After leaving Sikkim he studied at Sakya College in Rajpur

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: and later attended SOAS, University of London.

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He established Deer Park Institute as a center for "the study of classical Indian wisdom traditions" in March 2006

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1989, Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche founded Siddhartha's Intent

relations.subject: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 2001 Khyentse Foundation was founded by Dzongsar Khyentse.
